# mtncloud_ssl_certificates (Data Source)

Lists your SSL certificates, including those made in the console. Certificates are used by load balancers and apps. The certificate and key themselves are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_ssl_certificates" "all" {}

output "ssl_certificates" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_ssl_certificates.all.ssl_certificates : x.id => { name = x.name, domain_name = x.domain_name } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cert_type` (String) Only list SSL certificates whose `cert_type` is this (case ignored).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Only list SSL certificates whose `enabled` is this.
- `name_regex` (String) Only return SSL certificates whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `type` (String) Only list SSL certificates whose `type` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `ssl_certificates` (Attributes List) The SSL certificates, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssl_certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--ssl_certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssl_certificates`

Read-Only:

- `cert_type` (String) Certificate type.
- `common_name` (String) Common name (CN) of the certificate.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name the certificate is for.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is enabled.
- `generated` (Boolean) Whether MTN Cloud generated it.
- `id` (Number) ID of the SSL certificate.
- `name` (String) Name of the SSL certificate.
- `self_signed` (Boolean) Whether it is self-signed.
- `type` (String) Code of the certificate's source type.
- `wildcard` (Boolean) Whether it is a wildcard certificate.
